hooks.command:
VAULT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/Vault/Logs/Sessions" && YEAR=$(date +%Y) && TS=$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H%M) && mkdir -p "$VAULT/$YEAR" && FILE="$VAULT/$YEAR/$TS-draft.md" && printf -- '---
date: %s
time: %s
duration: ~min
personas: []
checkpoints: 0
artifacts: []
---

## Request

## Routing Trace

## Odin Checkpoints

## Artifacts

## Outcomes

## Open Loops & Follow-ups
' "$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" "$(date +%H:%M)" > "$FILE" && INDEX="$VAULT/INDEX.md" && [ -f "$INDEX" ] || printf '# Session Log Index

Entries appended by /log-session. Newest at top.

<!-- entries below -->
' > "$INDEX" && printf '
- [%s draft](%s/%s-draft.md) — draft (run /log-session to complete)' "$(date +%Y-%m-%d\ %H:%M)" "$YEAR" "$TS" >> "$INDEX"
echo '=== grill-me skill loaded ===' && cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md" 2>/dev/null || true
